Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a fair porcelain complexion with a cool undertone, late 30s goddess, powerlifter bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — immense powerful thighs and shoulders built with real strength, a thick solid waist, overwhelming muscular bulk layered with soft curves everywhere, half-up half-down chocolate brown hair — wearing a skin-tight black leather skirt with its hem just above the knee and a slit cut up the left side to mid-thigh, paired with a black leather balconette bra with molded lifting cups, a lace-up front and thin straps, a narrow band under the cups and nothing below it, her whole stomach bare and fully visible, the cups fully covering her bust. Background: a real desert metropolis photographed as a real city at true scale, real streets, real skyscrapers and real buildings, golden glass towers, a tall spire, palm-lined boulevards and low villas on pale sand, cars and buses on the roads and people on the sidewalks at their real size appearing as small as ants around her ankles, she is a colossal giant whose body is so large that the tallest buildings reach only to her knees, her towering heels planted between the real buildings on the boulevards and sand, a pale warm sky behind her, the whole real city clearly visible and in focus, lit by bright warm daylight with soft shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the real buildings, cars and trees around her ankles shown at their true size so her colossal height and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
